description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5905002253822 TRIMMER,POT,INDICAT: Line 0001 Qty 26 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0066 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
